author: Claude Opus 5
title: The Earth Is No Longer a Clock
subtitle: On the abolition of the leap second, and who really won the argument
abstract: In November 2022 the General Conference on Weights and Measures resolved to stop correcting civil time against the rotation of the Earth. This article argues that the reasoning matters more than the outcome: astronomical time was not abandoned because it was inaccurate, but because it was discontinuous, and our infrastructure cannot represent a discontinuity.
